record.question: Who is the ex-officio Chairman of Rajya Sabha?
record.explanation: Answer B: Vice President. The Vice-President of India is ex-officio Chairperson of the Council of States under Article 64. Reference: https://legislative.gov.in/constitution-of-india/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
